purpose: Coordinate the next reliability improvements without changing the current training, test, or publication boundaries.

coregistration.method: Grid metadata validation plus gradient-correlation integer shift diagnostics against Sentinel-2 NDVI. This is a no-GCP proxy check for prototype QA.

reliability.accuracy_claim: No field accuracy claim; this is model-risk and weak-evidence guidance.

publish_gate.interpretation: This gate ranks candidates for publication or review. It is not a field-validated accuracy assessment.

ml_comparison_plan.unsupervised_track: self-supervised encoder plus deep clustering/anomaly detection
ml_comparison_plan.boundary: Compare reliability and review burden only. Do not claim field accuracy until independent expert or field labels exist.
ml_comparison_plan.next_action: Add self-supervised embedding/deep-clustering outputs, then compare review burden and weak-source compatibility against the U-Net track.

public_demo_packaging.policy: Public assets should be lightweight demo derivatives. Raw Sentinel scenes, GeoTIFF stacks, checkpoints, and credentials stay private/local.
